name: autoyard-functions
description: AUTO YARD: yarış haberi telefon bildirimi + süresi dolan kayıtların temizliği + e-posta koduyla giriş (Cloud Functions 2. nesil) + hesap silinince veri temizliği (1. nesil Auth tetikleyicisi)

scripts.test: node --test test/news.test.js test/mail.test.js test/promo.test.js test/stats.test.js test/learning.test.js test/cleanup.test.js test/email_code.test.js test/account_cleanup.test.js test/iap.test.js test/refunds.test.js
scripts.cleanup-e2e: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cartown "node functions/test/cleanup_e2e.mjs"
scripts.e2e: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-cartown "node functions/test/e2e.mjs"
scripts.email-e2e: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cartown "node functions/test/email_e2e.mjs"
scripts.account-e2e: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cartown "node functions/test/account_e2e.mjs"
